text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-8243 fired -> severity: page. Affected node: antioch-12. Symptom: repeated CUDA OOM / nvml errors on inference-prod cluster; high GPU memory pressure. Affected service: infer-runtime, ~3 pods on node.

pagerduty: PDR-8243 triggered by metric: gpu_memory_utilization > 90% (5m). Escalation policy: primary oncall.

marta (oncall): ack. I'm on the page :rotating_light: Starting triage.

marta (oncall): Running quick checks: `kubectl get nodes antioch-12 -o json | jq .status.conditions` and `kubectl get pods -n infer -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=antioch-12`.

samir: I see repetitive `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in runtime logs; also NVML errors around the same time. Pasting last few lines: 

```
E10 02:11:34 runtime.cc:492] cudaMalloc failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
E10 02:11:35 kv_cache.cc:128] KV cache overflow - evicting entries
W10 02:11:35 nvml_util.cc:74] nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo failed: NVML_ERROR_UNKNOWN
```

marta (oncall): thanks. Any recent deploys?

samir: No infra deploy in last 2 hours. We did a model rollout earlier (v3.2) but only in canary. Not hitting main traffic.

ranjit: customer-impact check: Cloud metrics showing elevated 5xx for customers on infer-prod (p95 latency spiked, some timeouts). customer-success, can you confirm reports?

customer-success: Confirmed - we've received two support tickets from customers "BrightCart" and "LexaAI" reporting timeouts and degraded throughput ~02:05-02:25 UTC. We're drafting a status update.

marta (oncall): mitigation plan - short term: cordon node + evict runaway pods, restart the infer runtime on that node. Medium term: route traffic to fallback pool and scale fallback by +2 replicas.

dave: I'll prep the drain: `kubectl cordon antioch-12 && kubectl drain antioch-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`

marta (oncall): do it, but keep one replica pinned if customer workload is pinned to that node. Samir, kill the most offending pod once cordoned.

samir: Found a pod with massive KV cache growth: `infer-runtime-xyz-7f4b` using 28GB GPU memory. Killing now.

pagerduty: PDR-8243 acknowledged by marta (oncall). Time to ack: 30s.

samir: Killed `infer-runtime-xyz-7f4b`. Node freed ~26GB GPU memory, GPU util dropping. Logs show swap/thrashing earlier; possible prefetching gone rogue.

marta (oncall): Quick config patch: disable the KV prefetcher on this deployment to avoid repeated bursts while we investigate.

samir: Patching env: 

```
kubectl -n infer set env deploy/infer-runtime DISABLE_PREFETCH=true
kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-runtime -n infer
```

ranjit: Also bump fallback routing weight: `routedb modify pool=infer-fallback --scale +2` (ops command) — doing now.

customer-success: Sent interim status to affected customers: letting them know we're mitigating and routing traffic to fallback.

dave: I'm taking the oncall handoff now (arriving in channel). If anything else pops, ping me. I'll follow through on draining and postmortem.

marta (oncall): handing off to dave — leaving notes: killed noisy pod, cordoned node, disabled prefetch env, scaled fallback +2. Please create incident ticket and link customers.

pagerduty: PDR-8243 escalated to secondary oncall (dave) after 16m without full mitigation.

dave: Confirming node antioch-12 status: `kubectl get nodes antioch-12` shows `SchedulingDisabled`. Eviction completed. Monitoring GPU metrics for 15m window.

samir: We're seeing GPU memory stable now at ~35% on that node after evictions. No further nvml errors in last 5m.

customer-success: Customers acknowledged update; one customer pulled traffic off for 10m then resumed — reported latency back to normal.

marta (oncall): marking incident mitigated for now. Leaving as PDR-8243 -> mitigated (temporary). Follow-ups: write runbook entry for noisy KV prefetcher, add autoscale to fallback pool, and investigate model-level cache limits.

dave: I'll open the incident ticket and set a postmortem owner (samir). Planning root-cause timeline + proposed remediation.

samir: Preliminary hypothesis: aggressive KV prefetch + long-lived heavy requests caused unbounded GPU memory growth -> OOM & NVML errors -> eviction cascade.

marta (oncall): thanks everyone. Closing slack thread; will update incident ticket with timeline and customer impact window 02:05-02:25 UTC. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PDR-8243 status -> mitigated (temporary) by dave.

dave: final note — follow-up action items: (1) limit prefetch mem to 8GB per pod, (2) add OOM kill alert for GPUs, (3) simulate high-KV load in staging.
